questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Guinea?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Prefectures and regions” part of the Guinea article.

questions.proof: The capital of Guinea, Conakry, is a special area.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Guinea?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Guinea on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guinea article.

questions.proof: Guinea borders 6 countries: Guinea-Bissau, Senegal, Mali, Ivory Coast, Liberia, Sierra Leone.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Guinea?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Guinea article.
